adaptersdk.Serve takes a provider and returns an error, and is the adapter main entry point
Adapter binary is built with go build -o promptarena-deploy-myprovider .
func Serve(provider deploy.Provider) error
Serve starts a JSON-RPC server reading requests from stdin and writing responses to stdout
Serve dispatches each JSON-RPC request to the matching Provider method
Serve blocks until stdin is closed
func ServeIO(provider deploy.Provider, r io.Reader, w io.Writer) error
ServeIO is the same as Serve but takes custom I/O streams

Apply example using NewProgressReporter, Progress and Resource compiles against the current API
A pct value from 0.0 to 1.0 is rendered as message followed by (XX%)

GenerateResourcePlan parses the pack JSON and returns an error if it is invalid
GenerateResourcePlan generates agent_runtime, a2a_endpoint and gateway resources for multi-agent packs
GenerateResourcePlan extracts tool info and policies from the arena config
GenerateResourcePlan filters out blocklisted tools
GenerateResourcePlan parses tool targets from the deploy config
GenerateResourcePlan generates tool_gateway resources for tools that have targets
GenerateResourcePlan combines agent and tool changes into a single plan
Empty arena config or deploy config are handled without error and produce no tool resources

promptarena deploy login is the CLI command for browser-based autoconfigure
deploy.LoginCapability is advertised in ProviderInfo.Capabilities to enable login
Login dispatches over the get_login_url and complete_login RPC methods
The CLI reports login as unsupported for adapters that do not implement LoginProvider
LoginProvider is an interface type with GetLoginURL and CompleteLogin methods
LoginProvider.GetLoginURL(ctx, *LoginURLRequest) (*LoginURLResponse, error)
The CLI supplies the loopback callback URL and a CSRF state nonce to GetLoginURL
LoginProvider.CompleteLogin(ctx, *CompleteLoginRequest) (*CompleteLoginResponse, error)
LoginURLRequest and CompleteLoginRequest both carry the current deploy Config as JSON
promptarena generate --source <adapter> turns recorded sessions into regression scenarios
deploy.SessionsCapability has value sessions
Sessions capability is advertised in ProviderInfo.Capabilities
Session sourcing dispatches over list_sessions and get_session RPC methods
The CLI reports session sourcing as unsupported for adapters without the sessions capability and tells the user to upgrade the adapter
SessionSourceProvider is an interface type with ListSessions and GetSession methods
SessionSourceProvider.ListSessions(ctx, *ListSessionsRequest) (*ListSessionsResponse, error)
SessionSourceProvider.GetSession(ctx, *GetSessionRequest) (*GetSessionResponse, error)
The CLI re-checks Expectations on every fetched session regardless of server-side filtering
GetSession returns messages, pack identity, variables, workflow trace and every recorded eval for one session
Session requests carry the merged deploy Config with endpoint, workspace and api_token
SessionDetail.Messages is json.RawMessage holding a JSON array of PromptKit types.Message
A measurement eval has a Score and a nil Passed
A judged assertion or guardrail eval carries a verdict in Passed
The pack's declared threshold is included in eval data when the platform knows it
Redaction of session data is the platform's job and the adapter does none
An eval's Turn is the index of the user turn it answers
The assistant reply and tool traffic after a user message belong to that user's turn
Go package github.com/AltairaLabs/promptarena/v2/arena/generate provides the in-process session helpers
generate helper ViolatesAny(evals, expectations) exists
A session that never measured the eval violates ViolatesAny
generate helper UserTurns(messages) exists and returns user turn per message position
generate helper UserTurnIndex(messages, ids) exists and keys user turns by message ids
generate helper EvalResultsFromRows(rows, turnIndex) exists and resolves Turn
EvalResultsFromRows treats an unknown message id as a conversation-level eval
A score without a verdict leaves Passed nil in EvalResultsFromRows
generate helper HasFailedVerdict(evals) exists
HasFailedVerdict is true only for a recorded negative verdict
